# Browser regression fixtures

Fixture pages, browser runners, and their unit tests live in this directory.
The maintainer-facing run instructions and testcase documentation live in
[`../docs/README.md`](../docs/README.md).

Keep each fixture page and runner together, use a descriptive `<case-name>-repro`
filename, and add or update the matching document in `tests/docs/` whenever a
browser regression case is added or changed.
